name: Picture Frame
description: A digital picture frame for a space. Editors add photos by clicking Add or dragging them in, and everyone sees them as a grid of thumbnails; tap one and it fills the frame, tap again to go back. Turn on slideshow mode and every screen cycles through the photos together on one shared clock, at an interval you choose. Each picture frame in a space keeps its own display: whatever an editor puts up is what every viewer of that frame sees, and it remembers what it was showing, so a restart comes back to the same photo. Viewers and anonymous link visitors can browse the photos on their own screen without moving the display. Photos are downscaled on the way in (8 MB each at most). The photo list is the table photos in the space's frame data folder, and each photo and its thumbnail are files beside it, one folder per photo; the display is the frame's own session state.
